subject.title: [Bug]: Bootstrap files in agentDir are silently ignored — only workspace directory files are injected into system prompt

question: Should OpenClaw preserve the workspace-only bootstrap prompt contract and warn on bootstrap-named files in agentDir, or should explicitly configured agentDir become an additional trusted prompt source?
rationale: The current source and docs support workspace-owned bootstrap files, but user reports and open PRs show real silent-misconfiguration risk; loading agentDir files would change a security-sensitive prompt source and needs maintainer intent.

options.title: Land warning-only diagnostic
options.body: Preserve workspace as the only bootstrap prompt source, warn when bootstrap-named files are found in agentDir, and update docs/doctor guidance for the self-serve fix.

options.title: Adopt explicit agentDir loading
options.body: Treat explicitly configured agentDir as a trusted per-agent bootstrap source, but require clear merge/override rules, tests across run paths, and security review before merge.

options.title: Defer pending design
options.body: Keep the issue open and ask contributors to pause implementation until maintainers decide the permanent prompt-source boundary.

recommendation.title: Land warning-only diagnostic
recommendation.body: Preserve workspace as the only bootstrap prompt source, warn when bootstrap-named files are found in agentDir, and update docs/doctor guidance for the self-serve fix.

likelyOwner.reason: Peter has the strongest current history on bootstrap resolver ownership and broader security-sensitive agent-runtime boundaries.
